prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1446; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is regarding the collision you were involved in at the intersection in Katy, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name for the record.

A: [Claimant name]

Q: Can you walk me through what happened leading up to the collision?

A: I was driving through the intersection on a green light. I had slowed down a bit because traffic was heavy that afternoon. Then a vehicle coming from my right just pulled out in front of me and I couldn't stop in time.

Q: Did the other driver have a stop sign or a signal?

A: They had a stop sign. I'm pretty sure they didn't stop all the way before they went.

Q: Where did your vehicle make contact with theirs?

A: On the driver's side, the front of their car hit my passenger side door. It was a side impact.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you feel any injuries at the scene?

A: My right knee hit the dashboard and the console. It was sore right away, and by the next morning it was swollen and I could barely bend it.

Q: Have you seen a doctor for the knee?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that evening and I've been referred for an MRI and physical therapy.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm just hoping to get my knee taken care of.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
